comments.author: Laurencio
comments.body: The official Uncharted waters wiki does a better job of showing all the ports particular items can be found in, many many ports have this including all of the major cities. I get 99% of the information i need for the game from this site, but the others are usefull as well.

comments.author: George
comments.body: Past 2 days FS parts price inflated so fck'n much

comments.author: AliBayan
comments.body:
Not sure though, about if anyone's buying these really... Sat whole evening yesterday in Seville, trying to sell the money chests for 2.5M, larg mast for 3M, improved ropes for 1M... These are still honest prices I believe, and for hours I sold nothing.
Makes me wonder: does anyone actually buy gunports for 7M, large masts for 10M and improved ropes for 3M?

comments.author: Io
comments.body: Guess they are united to push price up even London's "5mil CS" is not pushed to 7.5m minimum.... Unless someone sell cheaper and steal all the sales price will stay up....

comments.author: Wen zhi
comments.body: My experience has been that people don't stockpile FS parts, but they will pay whatever price if they need it, you are bazaaring it and they see you in front of them. Once I sold a large mast for 10M. I was sitting literally next to Seville company shop that was selling large masts for 7M, lol.

comments.author: (Wen zhi)
comments.body: ...but on other occations I have had to bazaar for weeks at lower prices, I guess I was unlucky that no SB needing it *now* crossed my way.

comments.author: AliBayan
comments.body:
Yeah, I guess you're right. Having ships for like 5B or more, who'd care really if one-time-usage parts for pimping those are 2M or 10M.
For the quicker sale, it's probably also good to make stuff like gunports, which people need in much bigger amounts, than say money chest or casting net.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: You can buy these with the shopkeeper NPC at all capital cites in Europe. In addition most ports in SE asia with a shopkeeper will have them too.
